shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
git log --oneline -5 && git status
find app __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---NEXT CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json
cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -20 && echo "---" && ls node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | grep -iE "forbidden|unauthor|http-access"
echo "=== app/lib/auth.ts ===" && cat app/lib/auth.ts && echo "=== app/layout.tsx ===" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "=== app/page.tsx ===" && cat app/page.tsx
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

grep -rn "authInterrupts" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== forbidden.js ==="; cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/forbidden.js
grep -rn "authInterrupts" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map:" | head -30

grep -rn "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== conventions ==="; grep -rnoE "'forbidden'|\"forbidden\"" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-app-loader/index.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "FILE_TYPES\|forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-app-loader/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---types---"; grep -rn "forbidden" node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npm run start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null && break; done; echo "=== /admin status ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin; echo "=== / status ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
grep -oE "403 · Forbidden|403 · Forbidden|don.t have access to this page|restricted to administrators" /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; echo "=== title/h1 present? ==="; grep -c "Forbidden" /tmp/admin.html
cp app/lib/auth.ts /tmp/auth.ts.bak && sed -i "s/role: 'user', \/\/ Not an admin/role: 'admin',/" app/lib/auth.ts && grep -n "role:" app/lib/auth.ts

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; echo "BUILD=$?"; (npm run start > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null && break; done; echo "=== /admin as admin ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/admin2.html -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin; grep -oE "Admin Dashboard|John Doe|full administrative access" /tmp/admin2.html | sort -u
(npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; echo "BUILD=$?" > /tmp/build2.status) ; cat /tmp/build2.status; tail -8 /tmp/build2.log

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "old_server_still_up=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no server"; (PORT=3100 npm run start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3100/ 2>/dev/null && break; done; echo "=== /admin as admin (port 3100) ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/admin2.html -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/admin; grep -oE "Admin Dashboard|John Doe|full administrative access" /tmp/admin2.html | sort -u
cp /tmp/auth.ts.bak app/lib/auth.ts && grep -n "role: 'user'" app/lib/auth.ts && git diff --stat app/lib/auth.ts && echo "auth.ts restored (no diff = clean)"

for p in 3000 3100; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "port$p=%{http_code} " http://localhost:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo -n "port$p=down "; done; echo; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig drift check ===" && git diff tsconfig.json | head -20
cat .gitignore; echo "=== full tsconfig diff (functional part) ==="; git diff tsconfig.json | grep -E "^\+" | grep -vE "^\+\+\+" | grep -iE "next/dev|include"
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
for p in 3000 3100; do curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w "port$p=up " http://localhost:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo -n "port$p=down "; done; echo
pgrep -af "next-server|next start" | head; echo "exit=$?"
